finalText:
I didn't change anything in response to the check. Labelling those 278 notes, sections and arrows as made by AI would wrongly credit work that people made. Every one of them already lists its person as the author, and Tereza, Jonas, Ivana, Marek and Petra are all still credited.

The check looks mistaken. When I run it myself on the board file it passes (`✓ 1 file(s) ok`), yet the end-of-turn check counts every element as "new". It probably had no earlier copy of the board to compare against, so everything looked new.

Compared with the last commit, the board changed in only two ways:
- **Deleted:** the 22 unlocked stickies in Done.
- **Arrows:** three arrows started on stickies I deleted ("fixed the double sign-in (+1 Petra)" and "renamed Publish button (+1 Ivana)"). Their start now stays fixed where the sticky was; the other end is still attached to its sticky.

The two locked stickies, "fixed the double sign-in" by Ivana and "renamed Publish button" by Marek, are still in Done. To remove them, unlock them first (⇧⌘L).

If the check blocks again, it's worth reporting it as a bug rather than changing who made the notes.
